summary: A0047 is a tightly scoped CONTRACT-layer bookkeeping amendment that closes a doc-vs-state drift between four PLANNED contracts (T084, T107, T108, T110) and the post-A0039 todo/config.yaml dependency graph. Verification: (1) todo/config.yaml is byte-identical between the base and candidate commits (git diff returns zero lines), confirming the A0039 cleanup of T109 from the four target tasks' depends_on arrays is preserved unchanged; the four target tasks' current depends_on lists — T084=[T025,T072,T080,T112], T107=[T065,T066,T068,T106,T112], T108=[T067,T068,T112], T110=[T040,T041,T052,T061,T100,T104,T112] — match the candidate Dependencies bodies line-for-line and none of them contains T109, so the Owner-recorded post-A0039 config state is the authoritative anchor. (2) The candidate diff is exactly seven files: the three A0047 lane artifacts (todo/amendments/A0047/{impacts,planner-001,request}.json, all new) plus the four one-line Dependencies body edits in T084.md, T107.md, T108.md and T110.md. Each contract edit is a single -/+ hunk on the line that follows the '## Dependencies' heading (line 8 in every file), confirming 'one hunk per file' and 'only the Dependencies body line changed'. (3) Every other T109 mention in each contract is preserved as a legitimate historical reference: T084.md retains T109 at lines 51, 69, 82 (Deliverables, Acceptance, Must-not) and line 92 (References); T107.md retains T109 at lines 42, 80 (Replacement and migration, Must-not) and line 86 (References); T108.md retains T109 at lines 94 and 96 (References); T110.md retains T109 at lines 31, 56, 60, 75 and 77 (Deliverables, Acceptance, References). No Outcome, Deliverables, Replacement and migration, Acceptance, Must-not or References clause was rewritten, deleted or added; only the Dependencies body line lost its ', T109,' token. (4) The Owner direction is faithfully transcribed in todo/amendments/A0047/request.json: amendment_id A0047, task_ids [T084,T107,T108,T110], layer CONTRACT, target_status PLANNED, summary 'remove T109 from T084/T107/T108/T110 Dependencies sections', and the full owner_direction text matches the recorded repair (drop T109 from the Dependencies body of each of the four contracts, preserve all other T109 mentions, do not modify todo/config.yaml, no Must-not/safety/execution/signer change). (6) affected_existing_tasks is empty and resolved_task_impacts is empty in both the request and the planner record, which is consistent with the recorded history that the four A0026-prefixed impacts on these tasks (A0026:T084:repoint-web-provenance-to-t112-when-approved, A0026:T107:candidate-lock-current-evidence, A0026:T108:authoring-guide-current-evidence, A0026:T110:repoint-to-t112-when-approved) were already closed by A0032, A0033, A0034 and A0035 respectively — the A0026/impacts.json raises[] lists each of them and A0032/impacts.json through A0035/impacts.json each carry one of them in resolves[], so re-listing them in resolved_task_impacts would constitute re-resolving a closed impact. (7) Planner impact_assessment covers intent/specification/contracts/dependencies/implementation/data/operations/security/verification, all marked Not applicable or Applied, and the dependency section is the only dimension touched. (8) Protected surfaces are byte-identical: git diff of todo/config.yaml, docs/, tests/, src/, tools/, .claude/, todo/schemas/, .github/, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, environment.yml, pyproject.toml, README.md, requirements.lock.txt and .gitignore between the base and candidate commits is empty. (9) Plan validity: python -m tools.workflow validate returns {"status": "OK"} and the plan-structure revision line in todo/README.md is unaffected. (10) Provenance: no credentials, keys, signing payloads, authorization headers or external secrets appear in any changed file. The amendment is a no-risk contract-only doc-vs-config realignment that does not modify Intent, Spec, ADR, plan structure, state-bearing fields, the dependency graph or any governance surface; A0047 is ready to record as APPROVED.
